behavior.start: Opening Restock starts one shortage-only preparation. A player Buy press restarts preparation if later stock changes. No purchase or upgrade is automatic.
behavior.shortages: Known filled tiers/items are skipped on opening;missing remembered potion kinds and a configured kind without a remembered SKU are eligible. Saved recipe/material shortages use the existing planner.
behavior.passive: Bag/mail/profession pulses refresh counts without canceling owned queries,replacing proposals or restarting an idle/finished queue. A user-started initial loading wait may resume once reliable.
behavior.next: Matching purchase ACKs prepare the next shortage;each purchase still requires its own player press. User setting edits may replan once.
behavior.scanAll: Existing explicitly requested modern Scan all restock still refreshes all listed prices. Old AH retains scan/buy per item and has no Scan all control.

preferences.effect: Disabling upgrade prompts keeps current-tier direct purchases and craft-material comparisons available;stale disabled-kind choices cannot commit.

behavior.ui: Keep36px +2px gap+Block42px in existing80px card;full blacklist action in tooltip. Unchanged native enabled states are not rewritten on passive paints.
